page-tool.eventDescription: One successful call to a page tool: to_markdown, get_metadata, extract_structure, detect_technologies, audit_seo, check_broken_links or check_email_domain.

check-tool.eventDescription: One successful call to a check tool: trace_redirects, check_ssl, grade_security_headers, parse_robots, parse_sitemap, lookup_domain, read_feed, analyze_saml_metadata, check_oidc_provider, the developer tools (cron, regex, color, unicode, time zone) or the Hyperliquid market data tools.
